content: Brute force attack detected on VPN gateway 10.0.1.1. 523 failed authentication attempts from 185.220.101.47 in 10 minutes. Pattern consistent with credential stuffing. Affected accounts: vpn-svc, jsmith, bchen.

Phishing email campaign targeting finance department. Subject: 'Urgent: Invoice #INV-9921 payment overdue'. Sender: billing@acmecorp-secure.net (typosquat of acmecorp.com). 3 employees clicked the malicious link. Credential harvesting page observed.

Anomalous DNS queries from workstation WS-042 (10.10.5.42). 4200 queries to randomly generated subdomains of update-cdn47.io in 30 minutes. Consistent with DNS tunneling or DGA-based C2 beacon. Workstation user: jdoe.

Lateral movement detected. Account EMP-1042 (alice.chen) authenticated to 7 internal hosts within 2 minutes using Pass-the-Hash technique. Source: ws-042. Destination hosts include finance-sql-01 and hr-app-02.

Suspicious PowerShell execution on host fin-ws-011. Command: powershell -enc <base64_payload> invoking Invoke-Mimikatz. EDR blocked execution. Process tree: WINWORD.EXE -> cmd.exe -> powershell.exe. Macro-enabled document detected.
